lead.title: What is a lead
lead.body: A lead is a local business with its contact details: phone, website, email and reviews. In 5 steps you will run your first search for 1 lead.
lead.bodyRepeat: Review how to run a search in 5 steps. Since you have already searched, this walkthrough uses the normal minimum batch: 5 leads.

keywords.title: Choose what to search
keywords.body: Type the kind of business you want to find, for example “accounting firms”. You can enter several keywords separated by commas or line breaks.
keywords.hint: Type at least one keyword to continue.

location.title: Choose where to search
location.body: Select the country. State and city are optional and narrow the search.

count.title: Quantity fixed at 1
count.body: Your first search is a batch of 1 lead, so you can try the whole flow at a minimal cost: 2 credits.
count.bodyRepeat: The 1-lead batch is only for your first search. In this walkthrough the batch is 5 leads, the normal minimum, and it costs {credits} credits.

launch.title: Launch the search
launch.body: Press “Buscar leads”. It takes a few seconds to fetch and save the result.
launch.failed: No lead was found. Check the message, change the keyword or area and search again.

results.title: Here is your result
results.body: Your lead shows up in this table. Next you can export it with “Download CSV”, or use the pain points and enrichment columns to analyze it.
results.bodyRepeat: Your leads show up in this table. Next you can export them with “Download CSV”, or use the pain points and enrichment columns to analyze them.
